consumed_contracts.calendar: C1 tools.i6n_contracts.eligibility.load_calendar config (versioned weeks O, C, K; offsets 12/12); an assumed FX calendar stays labelled as assumed
consumed_contracts.bars: REQUESTED FROM DATA LANE: hourly EURUSD OHLC, close_time = instant the bar closes (bar covers (close_time-1h, close_time]); gaps allowed; split-bounded
consumed_contracts.eligibility_reports: report units' {horizon_hours: {mae, naive, eligible, n}} per family (ops TERMINAL.eligibility)

execution_rules: tools.i6dmo.strategy_adapter.EXECUTION_RULES (next-bar-open fills, force-close trigger t >= B-1h with fill by B, missing fill retained, SL first when both barriers touch in one bar, separate spread/slippage/commission/swap lines, one position per asset, 120-hour frequency window)
metrics: sharpe and sortino (UTC-day mark-to-market returns, 260 periods/year)

execution_policy_receipt.load: load_execution_policy(root) verifies the seal (EXECUTION_POLICY_TAMPERED) or returns None when absent
execution_policy_receipt.consume: execution_from_policy(receipt) -> {entry, execution, min_long, min_short, costs_sha256, cost_verification}; also for lane 2 final hooks
